pages.text: [#](53341a)The Mystic Branch is the witch's focus for stolen creature force. Old tales call it a wand for tracing spells in the air, but in the live port its role is simpler: it releases the creature power you have already stored within yourself.[#]()
pages.title: Mystic Branch

pages.text: [#](53341a)Work the night-only rite that turns an Ent Twig and Mystic Unguent into a branch on paired circles, for **3000 altar power**.[#]()
pages.title: Mystic Branch

pages.text: [#](53341a)Hold stored creature-power charges and use the branch to spend one, releasing your bound power directly — swiftness, impossible leaps, healing, transposition, or bat-light levitation, depending on what you carry.[#]()
pages.title: Current Use

pages.text: [#](53341a)The older air-glyph spellcasting is not fully restored, so treat the branch as a creature-power focus first.[#]()
